title: Investigating Health Related Quality of Life in Patients With Chronic Respiratory Failure
official: Investigating Health Related Quality of Life in Patients With Chronic Respiratory Failure
summary: To determine the quality of life of patients living with chronic respiratory failure and the impact interventions have on it.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Diagnosed with chronic respiratory failure receiving any of:

* Non-invasive ventilation
* Prolonged mechanical ventilation
* Mechanical insufflation-exsufflation therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Aged \<18
* Significant physical or psychiatric co-morbidity that would prevent compliance with trial protocol
sponsor: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust
